App release

v2.0.1 is live.

The Electron app, terminal client, and npm launcher ship together. This maintenance release focuses on updates, readable tool output, and one version source. The model is still v1.5; v1.6 remains a preview.

ChannelVersionWhat shipsGet it
Desktop appWindows installer v2.0.1 NSIS installer, blockmap, auto-update manifest Download ↗
Terminal clientPortable archive v2.0.1 Dizel-TUI-2.0.1.zip and its .cmd launcher Download ↗
npm launcher@d4niel-dev/dizel v2.0.1 Downloads and SHA-256 verifies the matching release npm ↗

The launcher needs Node.js 18+, Python 3.10+, and a model checkpoint. It downloads the app; it does not bundle Python or weights.

Changelog

What changed in 2.0.1.

A focused maintenance release: safer updates, readable tool results, and one version source.

AreaChange
UpdatesBoth clients Terminal checks, downloads, and stages releases in the background, applies them on quit or next launch, and exposes /update, /update install, and /check-update. Both surfaces mark available, downloading, and ready states. Dirty source checkouts are never overwritten.
Tool outputBoth clients Tool rows expand into inline drawers instead of separate modals. Edits show a numbered diff, writes show the file content, reads show line ranges, and searches show the query, URL, and results. Code is syntax-highlighted.
ApprovalsDesktop Write and edit approvals carry the target path, action, diff, and line counts before the call is allowed.
VersioningAll channels dizel_core/version.py is the single app version. set_version.py stamps the GUI, lockfile, and npm manifests, CI rejects drift, and desktop and terminal banners read the same source.
Distributionnpm The launcher now publishes as @d4niel-dev/dizel; install docs point at the scoped package.
DocsWebsite Spacing resets were corrected so section, footer, and card rhythm match the design system; release links and app labels now point at 2.0.1.
Research toolingv1.6 Reward-filter scoring and DPO pair selection scripts, with the Transformers version required by Qwen3 and Skywork reward models.

Availability

Two models.
One is ready.

The app runs v1.5 today. The 1.6 preview has no published weights and no downstream benchmarks; its training log is the public evidence.

Known limits

What is not ready.

These are the boundaries behind the preview label. They are not release notes for a finished version.

  • ×v1.6 weights are pending.The preview checkpoint is for evaluation; v1.5 is the model you can run.
  • ×Downstream benchmarks are not published.Only held-out BPB and validation loss are available.
  • ×2,048-token context.The app does not extend the model's window.
  • ×No vision path.There is no image encoder, image tokens, or multimodal projection.

Release policy

Gates, not a date.

The stable 1.6 release ships after six measured gates pass, not on a calendar date. The repository release policy is the source of truth.
